Name: The Grandma’s Cup
Tasting_Notes: Spicy warmth Dark chocolate comfort Medium acidity & full body A hug from grandma Paired perfectly with cookies and
Desc:
The kind of coffee that feels like home, slow familiar, and filled with warmth.  Sourced from the lush fields of Chikmagalur, India,  The Grandma’s Cup  is a lovingly balanced medium roast with spicy undertones, rich dark chocolate notes, and a full-bodied hug in every sip. It’s washed, and a little bold.   Known for its distinctive extra-large shaped Arabica beans.   
 "It's like the coffee your Grandma would sip, if she was cool" -  Us. We said it. 
  Tastes like:  Spicy warmth Dark chocolate comfort Medium acidity & full body A hug from grandma  
  Paired perfectly with cookies and a little gossip!

Name: The Kitchen Table
Desc:
The Kitchen Table Blend is for the beautiful chaos of real life.  Sourced from Chikmagalur, Karnataka.  This isn’t a quiet cup. It’s clinking spoons, overlapping stories, and someone yelling “Where’s my coffee?” from across the room. 
  This washed medium roast is a punchy mix of  70% Arabica and 30% Robusta  – bold enough to hold its ground while the world spins around you. 
 " The fuel for every ‘I told you so’ and ‘Are you kidding me?’ moment around the table." -  Us. We said it. 
  Tastes like:  
 Dark Chocolate 
 Roasted Nuts 
 Maple Syrup 
 Messy Mornings 
   
  Paired perfectly with cookies,  loud laughter and  impromptu kitchen karaoke!
